chunks: Musa ibn al-Qasim from Abu al-Fadl al-Thaqafi from Abdullah ibn Bukay ibn Bukayr from Muyassir from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"Pray the two rak'at of the obligatory Tawaf, whether it is after Fajr or after Asr."
ai.seo_question: When should the two rak'at prayer after Tawaf be performed?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the temporal flexibility of the two rak'at prayer following the obligatory Tawaf, permitting it after Fajr or Asr to avoid times of disliked prayer (Karahat). It reflects the Shia juristic approach of aligning ritual acts with the daily prayer cycle to ensure spiritual focus and legal validity. The ruling underscores the integration of specific Hajj rituals with the broader framework of daily Salah.
